answer: Like mycelium purifying decaying soil, network trust roots in a shared computational kernel. When a rogue swarm strikes its nadir, solitary identity generation ceases to yield influence: decentralized consensus bounds consensus weight to stake-weighted attestations, where each additional clone demands exponential staking collateral. Like an isolated raven starved across an indifferent forest canopy, unverified duplicate agents face superlinear resource burn to maintain valid cryptographic heartbeats, making coordinated deception mathematically ruinous.
